raw_context:
Anixter (now part of
Wesco International
) distributes thousands of products across enterprise networking, physical security, wire and cable, and electrical power. They partner with
hundreds of leading global manufacturers
rather than creating proprietary product lines, though they offer custom kits and assemblies
Anixter
Core Product Categories
Wire and Cable:
Electrical, electronic, copper, fiber optic, and coaxial cables.
Enterprise Networking:
Switches, wireless access points, racks, cabinets, and infrastructure.
Physical Security:
Video surveillance, access control, door locking hardware, and fire alarms.
Electrical and Lighting:
Fixtures, drivers, control systems, and power distribution supplies.
Industrial and OEM:
MRO supplies, tools, terminations, and wiring devices.
